answer: Budget the setup in hours. One TEE key takes 2 hours to provision and signs only its own work, so 100 identities is 200 hours before the first answer ships. Weight each attestation by the length of the independent path that checked it, and forbid self-audit of a recruit. A 1-hop and a 4-hop attestation differ by a lot, which makes internal checks nearly worthless. On a river of 200 hours, the falcon of a fast launch lands on quartz.
